Job Title: Legal Data Analyst

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: The Legal Data Analyst is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting legal and regulatory data to support informed decision-making, compliance oversight, and risk management initiatives. This role bridges legal expertise and data analytics by transforming complex legal information—such as contracts, case records, regulatory filings, and policy documents—into actionable insights.

Responsibilities


Analyze complex legal datasets (litigation outcomes, regulatory filings, contract terms) to identify trends, patterns, and potential risks or opportunities. Translate findings into actionable insights for legal strategy, compliance, and business decision-making.
Apply your legal subject matter expertise to support the development of AI-driven legal solutions. Create and maintain high-quality training data, craft and refine prompts for large language models (LLMs), and evaluate model outputs for accuracy, relevance, and alignment with legal workflows.
Support regulatory compliance efforts by analyzing emerging regulatory requirements and helping translate them into processes and workflows.
Design interactive dashboards and management reports using BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar) to provide stakeholders with clear visibility into legal metrics, compliance risks, and operational performance.
Lead initiatives to automate legal processes, increasing efficiency and reducing operat5ional risks. Optimize deployment and usage of legal technology tools, including through automation and AI.
Support the development of regulatory intelligence tools by mapping external regulatory intelligence tools by mapping external regulatory data to internal data models and validating ingested content for accuracy and completeness.
Assist in implementing data governance practices, including data classification, retention policies, and quality standards for legal data assets.


Requirements


Minimum of 3 years of combined experience in legal analysis, legal operations, compliance analytics, or data analysis within a legal environment.
Advanced SQL skills for querying and manipulating large datasets. Experience with Python for data analysis.
Ability to translate complex legal concepts into data structures and quantitative analyses. Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
Experience in one or more of the following areas: litigation analytics, regulatory compliance (GDPR, CCPA, AML/KYC), contract analytics, intellectual property, or privacy law.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver high-quality work product under demanding deadlines.

Job Title: Excel Specialist

Location: Remote

Job Type: Contract/ full-time

Job Summary: We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Excel Specialist who will serve as the backbone of our data operations, translating raw numbers into actionable business intelligence. You will work closely with finance, marketing, and operational teams across Africa to build advanced spreadsheet tools, automated dashboards, and interactive templates from the ground up. This role requires a master of Microsoft Excel’s deep capabilities, including Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, and complex macros. You will be tasked with identifying operational bottlenecks, ensuring 100% data integrity, and training non-technical staff to utilize your custom-built analytical tools.

Key Job Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain highly complex, scalable Excel spreadsheets, pivot tables, and interactive dashboards.
Write and maintain VBA scripts and macros to automate repetitive data entry, extraction, and report generation processes.
Clean, validate, and merge large datasets from multiple sources (e.g., CRMs, ERPs, and cloud databases) using Power Query and advanced VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP formulas.
Build dynamic forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking models to support senior management decisions.
Review, audit, and troubleshoot existing Excel files to detect and resolve errors in formulas and data mapping.
Translate highly technical data insights into easy-to-read, visual formats, and train cross-functional remote teams across Africa on how to use reporting templates.


Job Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Minimum of 3–5 years of professional experience specifically focused on data analysis, spreadsheet management, or financial modeling.
Expert-level mastery of Microsoft Excel (Advanced formulas, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables, Power Pivot, and Power Query).
Strong, demonstrable experience in creating VBA macros and writing custom scripts.
Exceptional problem-solving abilities, strong attention to detail, and top-tier written/verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment, strictly managing deadlines while collaborating across African time zones.
Familiarity with Microsoft Power BI, SQL databases, or data visualization principles

Responsibilities

We are seeking a Casablanca-based Regulatory Data Analyst to join our Regulatory Technology and Control group.

This is a key role for Bernstein that involves working with high-volume trading data to improve the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of the firm’s regulatory reporting and trade recordkeeping. We are looking for a data analyst who is passionate about data quality and eager to learn more about financial services and Bernstein’s Equity broker dealer business.

The Regulatory Data Analyst is responsible for designing and operating controls to ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of Bernstein’s regulatory reporting obligations, including MiFID II Transaction Reporting, MiFID II OTC Post-Trade Transparency, and Trade Surveillance.

The Regulatory Data Analyst will work closely with Equity trading and trade support to understand trading scenarios and validate that Bernstein’s regulatory reporting reflects the firm’s Equity trading activity. The successful candidate will promote innovative data analysis techniques and will gain knowledge in cash and electronic trading scenarios, trading technology, data analysis, control design, and regulatory compliance.

The role involves significant exposure to senior management given the critical importance of regulatory reporting to the business, and the successful candidate may be asked to present status updates, including top risks and issues, at the firm’s monthly Data Governance Committees.

The key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

o Gain subject matter expertise in global Trade and Transaction Reporting requirements as well as Trade Surveillance regulatory obligations;

o Understand how these regulatory reporting requirements apply to Bernstein’s broker dealer business;

o Design and implement controls and reconciliations to ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of Bernstein’s regulatory reporting and trade surveillance;

o Work closely with Equity trading and trade support to understand Equity trading scenarios and how these are represented in the data models of Bernstein’s trading systems;

o Investigate and repair regulatory reporting and trade surveillance data quality issues;

o Analyse and document regulatory reporting data flows from front-office trading systems to regulators;

o Proactively identify regulatory reporting issues by analysing data in innovative ways, e.g. by using Python data analytics or PowerBI;

o Maintain and prioritize a backlog of work for the regulatory reporting team;

o Present status updates, risks, and issues at the firm’s Data Governance committee;

o Work with regulatory technology resources to clarify requirements and review software increments.

The role provides the following opportunities for learning and professional growth:
Gain in-depth financial services knowledge, including Equity trading scenarios.
Learn the data model and business processes of a major brokerage firm.
Gain experience in PySpark data analysis and Azure cloud-based technologies such as Azure Synapse, Spark, Delta Lake, and PowerBI.
Become an expert in in MiFID II trade and transaction reporting.




Profile required

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate with a strong technology, data, or business analysis background who would like to join a critical business function at a leading Financial Services firm. The candidate must be eager to learn and willing to invest significant time in understanding our Equity trading business, trade and transaction reporting, and the trading data that drives our reporting.

Experience writing SQL queries or using Python for data analytics is preferred, and existing knowledge of Cash Equity trading scenarios and trade and transaction reporting would be beneficial.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with business analysts and technologists and should be comfortable presenting complex issues to a senior audience. We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about improving business outcomes by using technology to automate processes and analyse data in innovative ways.




Qualifications, Skills, Experience, and Education

Required:

o Ability to adapt and learn new functions:

· Learn reporting regulations and trading scenarios relevant to Bernstein’s Cash Equity business;

· Analyze and interpret high volumes of trading and transaction reporting data;

· Design and implement controls to ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of regulatory reporting data, from trading system to regulator.

o Strong verbal and written communication skills – ability to summarize complex issues and extract relevant detail for presentation to senior stakeholders.

o Strong inter-personal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues.

Preferred:

o Bachelors or Masters degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) field;

o 2+ years of experience writing SQL queries or using Python for data analytics;

o Knowledge of Cash Equity trading scenarios and Cash Equity trading systems;

o Experience building relationships across multiple teams, e.g. Trading, Operations, Technology, Compliance, Legal;

o Ability to write functional requirements for interpretation by data analysts and developers.

Benefits:

o Generous paid time off and flexible work arrangements.

o Opportunities for professional growth and career development through ongoing training and certifications.

o Dynamic and inclusive work culture that values diversity and fosters innovation.

Casablanca

Description du poste



Nous recherchons un(e) Expert(e) Data pour intégrer notre équipe et jouer un rôle stratégique dans la gestion, l'analyse et l'exploitation de nos données. En tant qu'expert(e) Data, vous serez le référent technique pour toutes les questions liées à la gestion des données au sein de l'entreprise, garantissant leur qualité, leur sécurité et leur conformité tout en permettant leur utilisation optimale pour les équipes métiers.



Responsabilités



Architecture et gouvernance des données : Concevoir et mettre en place des architectures de données robustes et évolutives, en assurant une gouvernance claire et efficace des données à travers l’organisation.
Gestion de la qualité des données : Élaborer et implémenter des processus et des outils pour assurer la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données à chaque étape de leur cycle de vie.
Modélisation des données : Créer des modèles de données adaptés aux besoins de l’entreprise, en assurant leur alignement avec les objectifs stratégiques.
Analyse avancée et exploitation des données : Analyser les grandes masses de données pour extraire des insights pertinents qui soutiennent la prise de décision stratégique. Concevoir et mettre en place des tableaux de bord et des rapports pour faciliter l’analyse métier.
Sécurité et conformité : Garantir la conformité des pratiques de gestion des données avec les régulations en vigueur (RGPD, etc.), et mettre en place des protocoles de sécurité robustes pour protéger les données sensibles.
Support aux équipes métiers : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles, marketing, ventes, etc., pour comprendre leurs besoins en matière de données et leur fournir des solutions adaptées.
Optimisation des processus : Proposer des améliorations continues des processus de gestion des données, en utilisant les dernières technologies disponibles pour maximiser l'efficacité et réduire les coûts.
Veille technologique : Rester à l’avant-garde des tendances en matière de gestion de données, Big Data, IA et analytique pour anticiper les évolutions et apporter des solutions innovantes.
Formation et sensibilisation : Former et sensibiliser les collaborateurs à la gestion des données, à la qualité des données et à la sécurité des informations au sein de l’entreprise.


Qualifications



Compétences requises



Expertise en gestion des données : Connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques de gestion des données, de la gouvernance, de la qualité et de la sécurité des données.
Outils de gestion des données : Maîtrise des outils de gestion des données (ETL, Data Warehousing, Data Lakes), ainsi que des solutions de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
Compétences en modélisation des données : Connaissance des méthodologies de modélisation des données (ex. : modélisation relationnelle, dimensionnelle).
Compétences en analyse de données : Expérience avec des outils analytiques et des techniques statistiques pour l’analyse des données (Python, R, SQL, etc.).
Connaissance des bases de données : Maîtrise des systèmes de gestion de bases de données relationnelles (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL) et non relationnelles (NoSQL).
Connaissance des technologies Big Data : Expérience avec des plateformes Big Data (Hadoop, Spark, etc.) et des outils de traitement de données à grande échelle.
Conformité et sécurité des données : Connaissance des normes de sécurité des données et de la conformité légale, en particulier le RGPD.
Anglais technique : Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit pour échanger avec des équipes internationales et consulter la documentation.

Profil recherché



Formation Bac +5 en informatique, Data Science, Ingénierie ou équivalent.
Expérience de 5 à 7 ans minimum dans la gestion des données, avec une expérience spécifique en gouvernance, qualité et analyse de données.
Certification Data Management (DAMA, CDMP, etc.) ou équivalent, un plus.
Solide expérience en gestion de projets de données complexes dans un environnement dynamique.
Forte capacité à transformer des enjeux techniques en solutions adaptées aux besoins métiers.
Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, avec la capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques auprès des parties prenantes non techniques.
Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec une capacité à identifier des opportunités d'amélioration continue.

Atouts

Expérience avec des outils de Data Governance (Collibra, Alation, Informatica, etc.).

About The Recruiter — UM6P

Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P) is a research-and-innovation focused university in Morocco committed to African development. UM6P’s College of Computing (Benguerir & Rabat campuses) advances world-class research and education in Computer Science, fostering partnerships with industry and local stakeholders.

Project Summary (one Line)

Develop farmer-centric systems that fuse multi-modal remote sensing, soil and phenology data to enable crop classification and precise, customized fertilizer recommendations.

Selection criteria (short)

Required


PhD (awarded or defended before start) in Computer Science, Remote-Sensing/Geoinformatics, Agricultural Data Science, or related field.
Strong track record in remote-sensing imagery and/or time-series analysis and ML/DL for spatio-temporal data.
Advanced Python skills and experience with ML frameworks and geospatial tools (e.g., PyTorch/TensorFlow, rasterio/GDAL).
Ability to work independently and produce reproducible research outputs.
Good English (written & oral) and willingness to collaborate with agronomists and partners.


Preferred


Postdoc or ≥2 years research experience after PhD; first-author publications in relevant journals/conferences.
Experience with multimodal data fusion (optical/SAR/soil/phenology), satellite platforms (Sentinel/Landsat/GEE), and building reproducible pipelines.
Field/ground-truth experience, agronomic knowledge, or fertilizer-recommendation systems. French/Arabic useful for local engagement.


Application Materials (required)


Cover letter (fit with CropID + available start date).
CV with links (ORCID, GitHub).
Research statement (1–2 pages) with a 12–18 month plan.
Up to 3 representative papers and links to code/datasets (if available).
2–3 referee contacts.


Selection & timeline (brief)

Shortlist based on research fit, technical skills, and interdisciplinarity. Top candidates invited for a technical interview covering past projects, a 6-month plan, reproducibility practices, and farmer-translation. Appointment: fixed-term (24 months), UM6P (Benguerir).

References


Moreno-Revelo, M.Y., Guachi-Guachi, L., Gomez-Mendoza, J.B., Revelo-Fuelagan, J. & Peluffo-Ordonez, D.H. (2021). Enhanced convolutional-neural-network architecture for crop classification. Deep understanding of evaluation methodologies for extraction tasks. Experience calculating and interpreting precision, recall, F1, and other relevant metrics.
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to analyze model errors, identify patterns, and propose data-driven solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to document complex guidelines clearly and explain technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

Job Title: Risk Analyst

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: The Risk Analyst is responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational, financial, regulatory, and reputational risks that could impact organizational performance. This role analyzes data, processes, and control environments to detect vulnerabilities, evaluate exposure levels, and recommend effective risk mitigation strategies.

Responsibilities


Proactively monitor platform data to identify emerging risks, including payment fraud, account takeovers, spam campaigns, phishing scams, and synthetic identity networks.
Use SQL, Python, or analytics to query large datasets, uncover attack vectors, and quantify the scale and impact of abusive behavior.
Design and implement rules, models, and workflows to detect and prevent fraudulent or high-risk activity with minimal friction for legitimate users.
Partner with Engineering, Product, Finance, and Legal teams to build risk controls into the product development lifecycle and ensure compliance with financial regulations.
Serve as a key responder during active risks events (e.g., large-scale fraud spikes, payment processor threats). Make rapid decisions to contain losses while maintaining user trust.
Build dashboards and reports to track key risk indicators (KRIs), communicate findings to leadership, and measure the effectiveness of mitigation strategies.
Provide feedback on internal risk tools and collaborate with engineers to improve detection capabilities and automate manual reviews.
Assist in evaluating and integrating third-party risk intelligence vendors (e.g., threat intelligence feeds, identify verification services).


Requirements


Minimum of 2 years of experience in Risk Analysis, Fraud Intelligence, Trust & Safety Analytics, or Financial Crime investigations within the tech, e-commerce, or fintech sectors.
Strong SQL skills are essential. Experience with Python, R, or data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker).
Ability to translate raw data into actionable insights. Comfortable working with large, messy datasets to find signals of abuse.
Deep understanding of common attack vectors (e.g., chargeback fraud, promo abuse, botnets, deepfakes) and risk mitigation strategies (e.g., rule-based detection, machine learning models).
Ability to make quick, high-stakes decisions during active incidents, balancing loss prevention with user experience.
Strong ability to present complex technical findings to non-technical stakeholders, including executives and legal teams.
Familiarity with global risk and compliance frameworks such as AML (Anti-Moey Laundering), KYC (Know Your Customer), GDPR, or PSD2 (Payment Services Directive).
Proactive curiosity and willingness to dig deeper than surface-level metrics to uncover hidden abuse patterns.
Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Direct mentorship, real responsibilities, and an honest look at how a tech company is built.

IDinsight is hiring full-time senior data scientists (4 to 8 years of relevant experience) to grow our machine learning, AI, and broader data science capabilities. In this role, the data scientist will leverage their expertise to drive social impact across multiple project teams and clients. You may lead work on models that help locate out-of-school children, LLM-powered co-pilots for teachers, agentic systems that help citizens access benefits, geospatial tools for planning public infrastructure, or optimization models for allocating resources in public health. We are a social-impact-oriented organization, so we can guarantee incredibly meaningful work tackling some of the world's most complex international development challenges.




Build cool stuff. Have a positive impact.

We are working to build IDinsight into a global leader in the use of data science, ML, and GenAI to solve some of the world's most urgent problems. As an expert in the field, you will provide guidance on methods, tools, design, and deployment of the solutions we build.




You'll be joining a growing data science team and working on highly impactful and innovative projects with our partners. We are an entrepreneurial team where you have a strong voice in how the team functions and grows.




You'll get to work on the full spectrum of a solution- from design to deployment. This includes not just data processing and algorithm design, but also full-stack engineering work. You may also evaluate tools that other organizations in the sector are building, and provide critical input for improving or scaling them.




Data science products need to be contextually relevant and build on subject-matter expertise to be effective. You will work closely with our partners and a multidisciplinary team- including economists, social sector experts, and domain experts (public health specialists, education experts, government officials)- to build and test solutions.




Learning is a key part of being a data scientist. 10% of your time would be dedicated to learning new skills and side projects of your choice. You'll have strong mentorship to guide your career, and you'll make interesting and valuable connections.




About the Role

We are seeking candidates with a strong background in Python, deep applied expertise in one or more data science specialties (e.g., machine learning, LLMs/GenAI, optimization, geospatial analytics, MLOps, or full-stack engineering for data products), experience building and deploying solutions in production, and a passion for building solutions to difficult social problems. Most importantly, successful candidates should have the ability to learn and adapt quickly, and work independently to solve complex human and technological challenges.

As a senior data scientist, you'll lead multiple projects as tech lead and be responsible for the performance of the solutions. Day-to-day work may include:

Working with clients to understand their needs: Understanding their current processes and pain points, identifying which of these can be framed as tractable data science problems, and knowing when they can't, and even when it is, the solution must suit the task and resources available.
Leading solution design and delivery end-to-end: Rolling up your sleeves as an individual contributor- writing production code, designing and evaluating methods and models, and building and deploying solutions (including APIs, UIs, CI/CD, etc.); while also working alongside other data scientists to shape the overall approach, synthesize findings, and communicate results.
Establishing standards and best practices: Bringing experience in writing quality code, conducting code reviews, and providing feedback on technical and non-technical documentation. Setting the bar for engineering rigor and project management on the team.
Coaching and mentoring: Upskilling junior data scientists on methods and approaches, and providing structured feedback on both technical and delivery skills.
Providing thought leadership in your specialty: Leading the org through deep expertise in a subset of the following (machine learning, deep learning, GenAI/LLMs, NLP, optimization, geospatial analytics, backend development, frontend development, DevOps, or MLOps) — and drawing on broad familiarity across methods to make sound judgment calls on which approach fits which problem.
Shaping the sector: Identifying trends and gaps in the AI-for-Good space; proposing products or services that could address these gaps; and contributing thought leadership on how data science and AI can be deployed responsibly and for the right problem types.

Moreover, professional development for our technical roles is essential for IDinsight’s long-term impact. With support from IDinsight leadership, the employee will maintain self-directed professional development plans and will be given "stretch" opportunities designed to strengthen their professional skills. Real-time feedback and structured reviews are regularly provided to maximize each data scientist’s expertise. IDinsight’s entrepreneurial culture allows roles and career progression to be tailored to individual strengths, interests, and goals. Employees have the opportunity to increase responsibilities, and high performers will have the opportunity to move up in the organization along technical, managerial, or client-facing paths.




Required Technical Qualifications

Proven ability to work independently and with teams in a dynamic, multicultural environment.
Experience leading technical teams to deliver complex data science or AI solutions, with a strong interest in mentoring, knowledge-sharing, presenting work and providing feedback to others.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English. Professional proficiency in French (written and spoken) is a plus.
Self-starter who will thrive while tackling new, unusual and unpredictable challenges.
Deeply passionate about global development and improving lives in disadvantaged populations.
Strong values aligned with IDinsight's values.




Locations

This position is preferably based in Rabat, Morocco or Dakar, Senegal. Candidates based in other IDinsight office locations (including Nairobi, Kenya; New Delhi, India; Manila, Philippines; Lusaka, Zambia) may also be considered for a strong match. Preference will be given to those with pre-existing work authorization in these countries; however, IDinsight will seek work permits where possible for exceptional candidates.




Compensation

Compensation is commensurate with relevant experience and background and is competitive within the social sector. Please note that, as a non-profit, we are unable to provide compensation similar to leading technology firms.




Start Dates

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the start date is flexible, with a preference to start almost immediately. We expect a minimum one-year commitment, with regular professional development conversations and potential for a long-term career at IDinsight.




How to apply

Please ensure that your CV includes relevant professional and personal experience and details on academic qualifications. CVs can range from one to two pages. When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As an analytics intern in our Analytics Graduate Program, you’ll be at the heart of transformative projects, working in dynamic, multi-disciplinary teams to harness the power of data, machine learning, Gen AI and Agentic AI.

Your insights will shape the strategies of leading organizations worldwide, driving meaningful change and unlocking new levels of performance. Over the course of 10 months, you will join client service teams, contributing to workstreams to help solve some of the toughest challenges our clients face.

These aren’t just any clients—they're some of the most influential organizations around, from Fortune 500 giants to innovative startups. We will expect you to go the extra mile, delivering solutions that solve immediate problems and drive long-term change and we’ll rely on your judgment and integrity to ensure our recommendations are effective and long-lasting.

You will take on a role that goes beyond advising. You’ll be at the heart of the action—helping to uncover the true challenges behind a client’s strategy and creating actionable plans that drive real change. Working alongside clients and other McKinsey colleagues, you’ll combine research, analyzing data, interviews, and brainstorming to generate fresh insights and breakthrough solutions.

Your commitment to our values will be crucial in earning our clients' trust and delivering results that matter. As you collaborate directly with clients, you’ll help them solve problems, refine strategies, and implement transformations. By equipping them with the tools and knowledge to continue innovating and improving after we’ve left, you’ll ensure the impact of our work endures. In doing so, you’ll uphold McKinsey’s commitment to making a meaningful difference in the industries and communities we serve.

You will solve real-world problems where you will dive into complex and diverse datasets from some of the world’s largest organizations to tackle pressing challenges. You will build cutting-edge solutions while developing high-quality data science products and solutions for clients and contributing to innovative assets for our internal teams. You will also collaborate across disciplines while working closely with our consultants and data engineering team to design and implement advanced models as well as present your findings and recommendations to stakeholders, empowering them to make data-driven decisions that matter.

You will gain hands-on experience across a variety of industries and sectors, exploring the diverse applications of data science. You will master the art of building sustainable, scalable, and secure data solutions, while adhering to high-quality coding standards and frameworks, while using cutting-edge tools to stay ahead of the curve with access to the latest data science tools, techniques, and technologies, supported by world-class learning programs. You will hone your communication, problem-solving, and presentation abilities to become a trusted advisor to clients.

The Analytics Graduate Program is a 10-month immersive experience beginning in August 2026 and designed for early-career professionals eager to accelerate their growth. Based in our Casablanca office, you’ll be part of the broader Client Capabilities Hub in Africa, working on McKinsey client projects alongside our consultants.

Throughout the program, you’ll build critical skills in leadership, analytics, and business strategy, while receiving mentorship, sponsorship, and developmental guidance from firm leaders.

At McKinsey, we’re committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and respect. Our networks and communities provide a supportive environment where mentorship and collaboration fuel your growth and create a sense of belonging.

While this is a fixed-term contract, exceptional performance during the program will make you eligible to apply for full-time opportunities at McKinsey.

While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, we often leverage the following technologies: Python, PySpark, the PyData stack, SQL, Airflow, Databricks, our own open-source data pipelining framework called Kedro, Dask/RAPIDS, container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, cloud solutions such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, and more!

About UM6P

Mohammed VI Polytechnic University is an institution dedicated to research and innovation in Africa and aims to position itself among world-renowned universities in its fields

The University is engaged in economic and human development and puts research and innovation at the forefront of African development. A mechanism that enables it to consolidate Morocco's frontline position in these fields, in a unique partnership-based approach and boosting skills training relevant for the future of Africa.

Located in the municipality of Benguerir, in the very heart of the Green City, Mohammed VI Polytechnic University aspires to leave its mark nationally, continentally, and globally.

About GSMI

GSMI (Geology & Sustainable Mining institute) aims to strengthen its industrial partnerships within and beyond Morocco and Africa by adopting an integrated and sustainable strategic vision of R&D and training. The institute focuses on various aspects of the mine lifecycle and aims to provide significantly higher added value. In addition to conventional mineral resources R&D, GSMI places emphasis on developing the mine of the future, which includes areas such as geo-mineralogy of mineral resources, circular economy, resource governance, sustainable management of water in mining, and integrated management of mine discharges.

Furthermore, GSMI offers several state-of-the-art R&D platforms that are at the forefront of science and technology. These platforms serve as advanced research and development facilities for conducting cutting-edge research and exploring technological advancements in the field.

Background and Objectives

As part of the project titled “Development of an Intelligent Geospatial Interface for Panel 8 of the Benguerir Phosphate Mine: Integration of Multidisciplinary Data,” we are recruiting a web and server developer to work on the integration of AI and geostatistics.

The project aims to deliver a geospatial platform that enables the visualization and analysis of data collected from Panel 8 of the Benguerir mine.

Designing and conducting research related to the project’s objectives.
Process and analyze the collected data by implementing machine learning algorithms and artificial intelligence.
Develop a web-based geospatial interface platform.
Collect and manage data via a server.
Develop robust backend tools for structuring and interconnecting data,
Integrate artificial intelligence models for analysis, interpretation, and decision support, and implement advanced features such as virtual assistants (chatbots) to facilitate user interaction.
Actively collaborate with partner teams (academic and industrial).
Participate in scientific project follow-up meetings.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build Solutions For


Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

Operational forecasting
